art.title: The Circumcision
art.why: Luke 2:21: a man kneels before a woman cradling an infant while a dozen people look on, in deep shadow. Jesus the Jew, circumcised on the eighth day.

art.title: Saint James Minor
art.why: James striding with a scroll under an arch on gold. PLEASE CHECK: Western tradition identified James 'the Less' with James the Just, the Lord's brother; say that this is a tradition, not certain.

art.title: Saint Peter
art.why: Peter with two keys and a book: the apostle who baptised Cornelius. No Peter-and-Cornelius or Peter's vision is in the NGA.

art.title: The Olive Orchard
art.why: Paul's olive tree: three women picking olives among the trees, in swirling strokes. (A cultivated orchard, not a grafting scene.)

music.why: A Christmas motet on the child born under the Law.

Every nation praising one God: the Gentile question answered.
Psalm 51, a psalm of the Temple, for the Temple's fall.

'Ransom captive Israel': the shared hope of the Messiah.
